test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The neighbour's words always __tantalise__ us.
solution: The correct answer is: **Provoke**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Tantalise **means to tease or tempt someone with something that is out of reach. (किसी को ऐसी चीज़ से चिढ़ाना या प्रलोभित करना जो पहुंच से बाहर हो) • **Example**: *The chef would tantalize the diners with the aroma of the dish before finally bringing it to the table.* • Marked option **Provoke **means to stimulate, incite, or elicit a reaction or response. (किसी प्रतिक्रिया को उत्तेजित या उत्पन्न करना) • **Example**: *His inflammatory remarks were intended to provoke a strong reaction from the audience.* • In this context, the neighbour's words are teasing or tempting the speaker. • Therefore, the most appropriate synonym is 'provoke', which means to stimulate or incite someone to do something. Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Pacify **means to calm or soothe someone. (किसी को शांत करना) • **Misguide **means to lead someone in the wrong direction. (किसी को गलत दिशा में ले जाना) • **Direct **means to guide or point someone in the right direction. (किसी को सही दिशा में मार्गदर्शन या इंगित करना) 4f:T600, The correct answer is: **DACB**
